Remarks: Compulsory for all ISEP students to participate in undergraduate teaching in NUS. Normally to be completed by the end of the 2nd year of enrolment at ISEP. Feedback will be required within 4 weeks of the teaching being completed. No MCs will be allocated for teaching. Marking hours cannot be used as part of teaching hours. Only the direct teaching or demonstrating hours can be clocked
Students are encouraged in the later stages of their research career to participate in supervision of JC, Honours and UROP students
